title: Personio Review (2026)
intro: Personio is evaluated here as a core HRIS / employee system of record — Personio is a GDPR-native HRIS for European SMB and mid-market teams: employee file, absences, workflows, time tracking, and preliminary payroll on Core. Homepage publishes Core from €7.60 per employee/month. CorePro (positions, unlimited docs/legal entities, API) and Apps (Recruiting, Surveys, Performance, selected-country payroll) are contact-sales. Annual subscription with 12-month minimum; ~10% off for annual upfront. One-time setup fee by company size. No USD list prices and no free plan. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Personio when EU GDPR-native core HRIS with a published euro PEPM floor is the job — not when you need US payroll, published USD PEPM, or frontline WFM.
verdict: Choose Personio when EU GDPR-native core HRIS with a published euro PEPM floor is the job — not when you need US payroll, published USD PEPM, or frontline WFM. Compare HiBob for culture-forward mid-market UX, BambooHR for US published PEPM, Rippling for HR+IT, and Workday for enterprise HCM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: EU SMB/mid HRIS with a published Core EUR floor is approachable versus Workday. Not lab-tested.
Primary job is GDPR-native core HRIS. Scored inside hris-core; recruiting is an App, not the core job.
Core people admin, absences, and workflows are solid. Payroll/recruiting depth lives on Apps.
European payroll/accounting connectors plus collaboration apps are adequate.
Employee self-serve exists; not deskless WFM.
Core analytics plus App surveys/performance — adequate, not HiBob culture-analytics depth.
Vendor claims ~10–5,000 employees; CorePro entities/API support mid-market growth.
Published €7.60 Core floor is clearer than HiBob quotes; setup fee and 12-month lock are the friction. No USD invented. Affiliate economics excluded.
In-product AI agents are marketed in 2026 without a separate public SKU — useful but not Ashby-class ATS AI.
